question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. 

The period of time in a person's life when they are developing into an adult
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Adolescence"** refers to the period of time in a person's life when they are developing into an adult. (किशोरावस्था)

 
 
• **Example: **Adolescence is often marked by significant physical, emotional, and psychological changes.
 
 
 
• **"Adolescence" **is the transitional stage from childhood to adulthood, typically involving the teenage years. (किशोरावस्था)
 
 
• **Example: **During adolescence, teenagers experience various changes and challenges that prepare them for adult life.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is '**Adolescence**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Adultery **(व्यभिचार): Voluntary sexual intercourse between a married person and someone who is not their spouse.

 
 
• **Example:** **Adultery **is considered a serious offense in many cultures and religions.
 
 
 
• **Teenage **(किशोरावस्था): The years of a person's age from 13 to 19.
 
 
• **Example: **Many** teenagers **face challenges related to peer pressure and identity formation.
 
 
 
• **Childhood** (बचपन): The period of time when a person is a child.
 
 
• **Example:** **Childhood **memories often hold a special place in our hearts.
